# Test template loading and rendering edge cases

# A template directory that parses to nothing usable falls back to the
# embedded templates rather than failing to serve.
md2html -templates bad-templates -http :9039 &
wait-port :9039

curl -s http://localhost:9039/doc
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

# -data-json makes the decoded document available to templates as .Data.
md2html -data-json data.json -templates data-templates -http :9040 &
wait-port :9040

curl -s http://localhost:9040/doc
stdout 'JSON Data: Test Value'

# A directory may override only the block it cares about.
md2html -templates named-templates -http :9041 &
wait-port :9041

curl -s http://localhost:9041/doc
stdout 'Custom Layout Template'

# Stop the script; the background server is terminated with it.
stop

-- doc.md --
# Template Test Document

Testing template system.

-- data.json --
{
  "testKey": "Test Value",
  "nested": {
    "value": "Nested Value"
  }
}

-- bad-templates/invalid.html --
{{invalid template syntax without proper closing

-- data-templates/layout.html --
{{define "layout"}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>{{.Title}}</title></head>
<body>
{{if .Data}}
<div>JSON Data: {{.Data.testKey}}</div>
{{end}}
{{.Content}}
</body>
</html>
{{end}}

-- named-templates/layout.html --
{{define "layout"}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>Custom Layout Template</title></head>
<body>{{.Content}}</body>
</html>
{{end}}
